description: Retrieval eval over the library fixture (src/test/resources/eval/library). A question passes at k when any expected target is among the top k results. A target is 'File.java' (any chunk of that file) or 'File.java#member' (a method, constructor or type named member in that file).
thresholds_note: Regression baseline measured 2026-10-19 with the CI HashingEmbeddingModel (HYBRID 75.0% / 0.510, VECTOR 62.5% / 0.475, KEYWORD 75.0% / 0.580), minus a small margin for tie ordering. Raise these when retrieval improves; never lower them to make a build pass.
